spans.s:
आलु f. (-लुः) A pitcher, a small water jar.
 mn. (-लुः-लु)
 1. An esculent
root, (Arum campanulatum:) in the modern dialects this name is
applied to the yam, potatoe, &c.
 2. A raft, a float.
 m. (-लुः) An owl.
E. ऋ to go, and उण् affix, आरु what goes, (in the earth, water, &c.)
the initial is lengthened, and र is changed to ल.

अलुब्ध mfn. (-ब्धः-ब्धा-ब्धं) Moderated, content, not covetous.
 E. अ neg. and
लुब्ध covetous.

अलून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Uncut, unshorn.
 E. अ neg. लून cut.

आलून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Cut, out off.
 E. आङ् before लून cut.

आलुक m. (-कः)
 1. A name of the chief of the Nagas or serpent race:
see शेष.
 2. An esculent root: see आलु.
 E. कन् added to the preceding.
